description: Integration test for aidr_commit_gateway.py verdict-check enforcement. Must: (1) call aidr_commit_gateway with VERDICT_REQUIRED payload (trust_synthesiser output); (2) assert it REFUSES commit for CAUTION_LIMITED and HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED verdicts; (3) assert it ALLOWS commit for TRUSTED_GENERAL and TRUSTED_RESEARCH; (4) assert injection_resilience score (weight 1.6) is included in commit payload when forwarded. This is NOT a rebuild of aidr_gateway_verdict_test.py (which is quarantined) — this is new integration wiring. Must use write_service (:8772).
